Metadata.title: dowieziemycie.pl — your neighbor with a van, 24/7
Metadata.description: Safe transfer Kraków–Rybna, Liszki, Czernichów, Kaszów, Alwernia and nearby villages, any time of day or night. Book online, track your driver live.

TrackByCode.title: Track your driver
TrackByCode.lead: Enter the 4-digit code you got by SMS from your driver — it works from one hour before the ride until 4 hours after the scheduled start.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.lead: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved. Check the links below or head back home.

Blog.heading: Local transport blog around Kraków
Blog.lead: Practical guides about late-night rides from Kraków, event transport, concerts, wedding guest transfers and safe trips to Rybna, Liszki, Czernichów, Kaszów and Alwernia.

DriverEta.title: Driver ETA
DriverEta.unavailable: No driver is online right now — call us to arrange a time.

StatusLegend.title: See exactly what's happening with your ride
StatusLegend.description: Before you even get in, you know where the car is and how many minutes until it's at your door — in Rybna, Liszki or Czernichów, any time of day.
StatusLegend.enRouteDesc: See the car on the map and a minute counter

PricingTiers.title: Clear, distance-based pricing
PricingTiers.description: We calculate the real route distance automatically. Book ahead for a lower price — on-demand rides are also possible, at a higher rate.

HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.step1Body: Book a local ride online and pay the deposit via BLIK. An event or a longer trip is arranged by phone or WhatsApp — always quoted individually.
HowItWorks.step2Title: Track the driver on the map
HowItWorks.step2Body: See the car's exact live position and a real ETA. Zero uncertainty about whether anyone's actually coming.
HowItWorks.step3Title: Get in — safe and on time
HowItWorks.step3Body: The price set at booking doesn't change. No haggling on arrival, any time of day or night.

Hero.trustBar: Available 24/7 · insured vehicle · fixed price, known upfront

Pillars.title: Two ways we can get you there
Pillars.eventsBody: Concerts, bachelor and bachelorette parties — one van, one driver for the whole evening. Individually quoted, just call and plan it out.
Pillars.localBody: Everyday transport around the Czernichów area and a safe, comfortable ride home — including from Kraków at night, once public transport has stopped.

TopicTiles.eyebrow: What else you can book us for
TopicTiles.title: Pick what you need
TopicTiles.concertsBody: We pick up the whole group and drop everyone home — even past midnight.
TopicTiles.stagBody: A flexible route across a few spots, the driver waits between stops.
TopicTiles.henBody: Same as the bachelor party — calm transport, no clock-watching.
TopicTiles.nightBody: Heading back from Kraków once public transport has stopped — we drop you right at the door.
TopicTiles.businessBody: Shift commutes, company events, or van hire with a driver, e.g. Kraków–Berlin.

Rezerwacja.title: Book a ride
Rezerwacja.lead: Enter the addresses, pick a time — pay the deposit online, we handle the rest by SMS.
Rezerwacja.seoDescription: Book a local ride around Kraków — enter addresses and a time, pay the deposit online, track your driver live.

Routes.title: Local transport around Kraków
Routes.description: Regular runs to the Czernichów, Liszki, Alwernia and Krzeszowice municipalities — every day, any time of day or night.

RoutePage.exampleFrom: Route from Kraków's Main Square, booked in advance

Fleet.title: Our fleet
Fleet.description: A comfortable car, one standard. Room for the whole family or a group of friends heading home from the same party.
Fleet.empty: The fleet will show up here as soon as a vehicle is added in the admin panel.
